<div id="cur-dot"></div>
<div id="cur-ring"></div>


<header id="mainHeader">
  <a href="#home" class="logo-wrap">
    <div class="logo-img-wrap">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Interior Duct Ltd">
    </div>
    <div class="logo-text-block">
      <div class="logo-name">Interior Duct Ltd</div>
      <div class="logo-tagline">Functionality, Durability &amp; Aesthetics</div>
    </div>
  </a>
  <nav>
    <a href="#home">Home</a>
    <a href="#collection">Shop</a>
    <a href="#doors">Doors</a>
    <a href="#showroom">Showroom</a>
    <a href="#ai-design">AI Design</a>
    <a href="#about">About</a>
    <a href="#contact">Contact</a>
  </nav>
  <div class="hdr-right">
    <select class="curr-sel" id="currSel" onchange="setCurrency(this.value)">
      <option value="NGN">&#8358; NGN</option>
      <option value="USD">&#36; USD</option>
      <option value="GBP">&#163; GBP</option>
      <option value="EUR">&#8364; EUR</option>
    </select>
    <button class="hdr-icon-btn" title="Cart" id="cartBtn">&#128722; <sup id="cartCount">0</sup></button>
    <button class="hdr-cta btn" onclick="scrollTo('ai-design')">AI Designer</button>
    <button class="nav-toggle" id="navToggle" onclick="toggleMobileNav()" aria-label="Menu">&#9776;</button>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- Mobile Nav -->
<div class="mobile-nav" id="mobileNav">
  <a href="#home" onclick="closeMobileNav()">Home</a>
  <a href="#collection" onclick="closeMobileNav()">Shop Collection</a>
